description: Print a saved design on a label printer through PrintHub. Needs PrintHub installed at the printer's place and a Professional or higher plan. Each label counts against the monthly label allowance (copies: 5 is five labels). Get the printer code from list_printers. The keys of values are the design's field names; get them from get_design. A field left out prints empty. Print only when the user asked for it, and never print in a loop or repeat a print without the user's say-so. Returns a jobId; call get_print_job to see whether it printed. If the answer to this call is lost, retry once with the same idempotencyKey: that returns the same job instead of printing twice.

copies.description: Number of labels, 1 to 1000 (default 1). Each is one label from the allowance.

idempotencyKey.description: Only for retrying a print whose answer was lost: the key the earlier call reported. Leave out for a new print; a new UUID is made.

org.description: Organization: an id, a slug or ref:<your customer id>. Leave out to use your default organization.

site.description: Site slug, e.g. "oakland". Leave out for the whole organization.

values.description: Field name → value, e.g. { "sku": "PEL-1044", "bin": "A-14" }. Field names come from get_design.

name: print_to_printer
title: Print to Printer
